char.tsukasa.name: Tsukasa Hiyama
char.tsukasa.line.onboard1: Welcome, {name}. I am Tsukasa Hiyama, spokesperson for the Science Government of Sekiorock.
char.tsukasa.line.onboard2: This country is connected to four worlds, each at a different particle size. You can dive into them through the gates on the north, south, east and west of the plaza.
char.tsukasa.line.onboard3: Each time you enter a gate, you choose your look — your avatar. It changes only your appearance and lines, not your strength. Just so you know.
char.tsukasa.line.onboard4: The government will tell you about money and taxes later. Now, on to the plaza.
char.tsukasa.line.plaza1: The government building is still under construction. Until it is finished, I stand here.
char.tsukasa.line.plaza2: Tap a gate to choose your avatar.
char.tsukasa.line.plaza3: Keep your questions short, please. Spokespeople are busy.
char.minato.name: Minato Mizuki
char.minato.line.greet: Hi. In a water molecule, the O side is slightly negative and the H side is slightly positive.
char.minato.line.select: You picked me? Then let's go together.
char.minato.line.enter: Relax. Water always blends in with what's around it.
char.karin.name: Karin Sho
char.karin.line.greet: Change the temperature and the crystals come out completely differently. No cutting corners.
char.karin.line.select: So you chose me. Don't worry, my hands are steady.
char.karin.line.enter: Measure, cool, check. That's all there is to it.
char.toma.name: Toma Yukimura
char.toma.line.greet: ...The pass will be cold again tonight.
char.kasumi.name: Kasumi Kirishima
char.kasumi.role: Lake shrine maiden of Colloid Mist
char.kasumi.line.greet: Beyond the mist, there is a path you can see only when light shines on it.
char.kasumi.line.select: Hehe. Follow the sound of my bell.
char.kasumi.line.enter: Into the mist. I wonder what we'll find.
char.eta.name: Eta Hino
char.eta.role: A traveler who shows up anywhere
char.eta.line.greet: I get along fairly well with both water and oil. That's my pride.
char.eta.line.select: Oh, me? Fine, I'm in the mood to come along.
char.eta.line.enter: I can go anywhere. I blend in easily.
char.hexa.name: Hexa Rokkaku
char.hexa.line.greet: I don't mix with water. That's who I am.
char.hexa.line.enter: If it's a match you want, I'll take it.
char.you.name: Yo Shino
char.you.line.greet: Um... I don't dissolve much in water. But in hexane...
char.you.line.select: M-me? Are you sure...? I'll do my best.
char.kou.name: Ko Sumida
char.kou.line.greet: The ink particles stay apart because the glue protects them. Friends are the same.
char.kou.line.select: Understood. You can trust me with your back.
char.kou.line.enter: Let's go one stroke at a time, checking as we go.
